caption:
You hold on with a clenched fist. But what if nothing in your hand was ever yours to begin with? (Galatians 6:6 devotional)

You guard what you have like an owner, so every act of giving feels like something torn out of your fist. But nothing was ever yours — it was placed in your hands on trust, which makes an open hand simply what a steward looks like. Real sharing costs something actual; if you've received someone's spiritual blessing, generosity back is not loss but the fitting response of one entrusted with everything.
